note: The Falkland Islands Government, which issues the Falkland Islands pound, states on its Currency page that the pound has parity with sterling and that both are used interchangeably; read 2026-10-30.

sources.title: Currency (Falkland Islands Government)
sources.said: The Falkland Islands Pound (ISO4217 currency code FKP) has parity with Sterling. ... All Falkland Islands currency has been issued by Falkland Islands Government, and is fully backed by realisable securities held in Sterling.
